prompt:
Edit the provided original OtherWise wordmark into a CLEAN transparent PNG logo.
The attached image is the sole design reference and edit target. Carefully faithfully redraw its exact typography as smooth solid flat silhouettes, keeping the original letter style, proportions, weight, capitalization, spacing, and two-color split.
Exact word: OtherWise. "Other" is periwinkle blue as in the reference, "Wise" is very pale silver white as in the reference.
Correct the LAST lowercase e: REMOVE the tiny thin gray horizontal bar that protrudes from its LEFT side into the preceding s. That unwanted bar sits around the mid-height of the final e. Keep the real e crossbar contained WITHIN its rounded outline. There must be an empty transparent gap between the s and final e, absolutely no connection or projecting line. Also remove the similar tiny accidental gray connector in the gap between the first e and r, leaving both as clean separate letters.
VERY IMPORTANT: The output is ONLY nine clean solid opaque letter shapes (plus the dot on i) on TRUE TRANSPARENCY. All pixels outside the clean letter silhouettes, including every interior letter counter and every gap, must be transparent. Do NOT retain any sampled background noise, dark fringes, blue or white speckles, cyan blobs, little bridges between letters, glow, soft haze, motion streaks, scattered flecks, stray pixels or texture. This is clean flat vector-style graphic artwork with pristine antialiased curves and no texture. Do not attempt a noisy color-key extraction; reconstruct only the clean letter shapes accurately from the original.
Wide landscape 3:1 canvas, same centered composition as reference. Transparent background with real alpha channel. NO opaque backdrop of any color, NO visible checkerboard pattern, NO shadow. No additional text or icons.
validation: RGBA alpha channel confirmed; transparent background and cleaned e contours inspected over dark and light backgrounds in browser.
